items.title: Darker Than Black
items.reason: A dark supernatural science-fiction conspiracy thriller built around Contractors: covert assassins and spies with varied paranormal abilities and explicit costs. Across the first season, Hei moves through infiltration, pursuit and deception between rival agencies while Hell's Gate, the Contractors' origins, Amber, the Syndicate and the South American catastrophe are progressively revealed, producing sustained mystery, cat-and-mouse pressure, violent action and a deepening hidden-system conspiracy.
